requirement.evidence: the landlord shall provide the tenant with a written statement, on or before the date the lease is signed, of the amount of the higher security and an explanation why the higher security amount is being charged. The additional amount of security shall be returned to the tenant after no more than six months of residency if the tenant is not in arrears for any rent due during that period.
requirement.note: The statute says higher security 'due to the credit history, credit score, housing history, or other factor related to the tenant'; the card narrows it to credit or housing history. Minor.

key_value.evidence: The additional amount of security shall be returned to the tenant after no more than six months of residency if the tenant is not in arrears for any rent due during that period.
key_value.note: The statute says returned after no more than six months of residency, which the card words as 'within 6 months'; roughly equivalent, and the arrears condition is omitted.
